role: The style of a chat component: colour, bold/italic/strikethrough/underline/obfuscated flags, click and hover events, resolved through a parent chain rooted at the immutable rootStyle, plus its Gson serializer.
scope_reason: In scope: it colours the chat lines GuiNewChat (in scope) draws (the achievement name is green, Achievement.func_150951_e); getFormattingCode's codes reach the frame.

members.name: chatHoverEvent
members.note: hover and hover_value: SHOW_ACHIEVEMENT, the only one the game's server lines carry (SHOW_ITEM needs a named item, an anvil)

members.note: ChatStyle.rootStyle is reached only through the private ChatStyle.getParent(), whose callers read its getters (getColor, getBold, ...); nothing calls a setter, a copy or getFormattingCode on it (ChatStyle.getFormattingCode recurses through parentStyle, never getParent), and its setters throw UnsupportedOperationException by design

notes: Every S02 the server sends is compared per row: the oracle's rows carry each tick's S02s (Rows.s02: the IChatComponent.Serializer JSON and GuiNewChat's iterated parts) and test_snapshots and play --check compare csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_s02_check against the queue (lane/idxchat, DEVLOG 2026-09-27). The colours the server's lines use: green and dark purple (achievements), grey (StatBase), red (build.tooHigh). idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
